ut_uinta_mountains.name: Uinta Mountains
ut_uinta_mountains.note: SummitPost mid-Jul to mid-Sep, Climbing.com Jul-Sep, Kaya late Jun to early Oct; shared window Jul-Sep.

wv_endless_wall.name: Endless Wall
wv_endless_wall.note: NPS: best months usually late April to mid-June and mid-September to late October; a guide agrees spring and especially October/autumn.

mt_hyalite_canyon.name: Hyalite Canyon
mt_hyalite_canyon.note: Ice season named (about Dec-Apr) but no source found naming the rock-climbing months; area mixes both, so not set.

al_little_river_canyon.name: Little River Canyon
al_little_river_canyon.note: Only a travel site names months (Apr, May, Oct peak); MP says practically year round; no climbing source with months.

ab_cougar_canyon_creek.name: Cougar Canyon (Creek)
ab_cougar_canyon_creek.note: SummitPost: driest June through September, nobody climbs in winter; Bow Valley rock season April-October in general; some flood/June closures.

nv_calico_basin.name: Calico Basin
nv_calico_basin.note: Guide: October to early April best at Red Rocks; sport crags like Calico best Nov-Mar; summer dangerously hot.

ca_lower_merced_river_canyon.name: Lower Merced River Canyon
ca_lower_merced_river_canyon.note: Only raptor-closure dates found (Mar-mid Aug at Arch Rock); no source naming climbing season months.

ca_indian_cove_campground.name: Indian Cove Campground
ca_indian_cove_campground.note: Bouldering guides: fall through early spring/spring; visitor sites name October-May; summer too hot. Months partly mapped from season words backed by Oct-May sources.

co_elevenmile_canyon.name: Elevenmile Canyon
co_elevenmile_canyon.note: Sources give only seasons (fall favored, summer hot/crowded); no months named.

co_west_ridge_the.name: West Ridge, The
co_west_ridge_the.note: Eldorado sources say spring and fall (one says April-October, winter sun on West Ridge) but disagree; no firm months.

va_great_falls.name: Great Falls
va_great_falls.note: Sources only say year-round / spring-through-fall; no months named.

nc_rumbling_bald.name: Rumbling Bald
nc_rumbling_bald.note: Lake Lure: fall and winter; hiking guide peak November-March; resort blog fall/winter/early spring, avoid summer (poison ivy, heat).

ca_scheelite_canyon_pratt_s_crack_gully.name: Scheelite Canyon / Pratt's Crack Gully
ca_scheelite_canyon_pratt_s_crack_gully.note: Sources say spring and fall / late spring to late fall without naming months; Scheelite is shady and cold in spring.

nc_linville_gorge.name: Linville Gorge
nc_linville_gorge.note: A listing names April, May, September, October; climbing guides say spring and fall, avoid summer heat and winter ice.

tn_obed_clear_creek.name: Obed & Clear Creek
tn_obed_clear_creek.note: Tripbase: April-May and October-November sweet spots; Gripped: climbable year round, fall and spring stand out, summer humid.

ak_seward_highway_2.name: Seward Highway
ak_seward_highway_2.note: Ice season: forms late November (Thanksgiving) through late March; guide gives December-March. Ice/mixed corridor; rock season not covered.

co_pink_floyd_area.name: Pink Floyd Area
co_pink_floyd_area.note: Nine Mile bouldering described as year round / March-December; nothing specific to months for Mecca area.

ut_zion_national_park.name: Zion National Park
ut_zion_national_park.note: NPS: best conditions March-May and September to early November; summer over 100F; climbing travel site lists Mar-May, Oct-Nov.

ut_maple_canyon_road.name: Maple Canyon Road
ut_maple_canyon_road.note: theCrag: best season May to fall; campground open about May-October with peak months May, June, Sep, Oct; winter is ice only.

al_sand_rock.name: Sand Rock
al_sand_rock.note: Sources say cool months / winter sun walls, peak Oct-Nov by one guide; no consistent months.
